io.milvus.bulkwriter.request.import_

Class CloudImportRequest

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.milvus.bulkwriter.request.import_.BaseImportRequest
      • io.milvus.bulkwriter.request.import_.CloudImportRequest
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Serializable

    public class CloudImportRequest
extends BaseImportRequest
    Request for importing data from a storage bucket into a Zilliz cloud instance.

    Supports multi-path, folder, or single-file import through object URLs. For project database deployments, use projectId and regionId instead of clusterId.

    See Also:
